observation.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -s http://localhost:9200 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ES up after $i"; break; fi; sleep 2; done; echo "=== CORS check (Origin http://localhost) ==="; curl -s -i -X GET "http://localhost:9200/index_data_explorer_demo/_search" -H 'Origin: http://localhost' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"size":1}' 2>&1 | grep -iE "^HTTP|access-control-allow"; echo "=== Preflight (OPTIONS) ==="; curl -s -i -X OPTIONS "http://localhost:9200/index_data_explorer_demo/_search" -H 'Origin: http://localhost' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type' 2>&1 | grep -iE "^HTTP|access-control"
